copy.titleEn: A SPRITZ AND A MOMENT ON THE BENCH

title.en: A spritz and a moment on the bench
title.de: Ein Spritz und eine Pause auf der Bank

deck.en: An orange spritz and the whole bench to himself.
deck.de: Ein Spritz und eine Pause auf der Bank

intro.ko: 줄무늬 쿠션이 깔린 벤치에 팔을 걸치고 오렌지 스프리츠를 든 오후. 단추를 몇 개 연 세이지 셔츠를 워시드 블랙 쇼츠가 차분하게 받쳐 주고, 선글라스는 머리 위로 올렸어요.
intro.en: An arm along the back of a cushioned bench, an orange spritz in hand. A pale sage shirt with a few buttons undone sits over washed black shorts that ground the colour, and the sunglasses are pushed up into the hair.
intro.de: Den Arm auf der Banklehne, einen Spritz in der Hand. Ein hell salbeigrünes Hemd mit ein paar offenen Knöpfen trifft auf verwaschene schwarze Shorts, die die Farbe erden; die Sonnenbrille sitzt im Haar.

copy.pullQuoteEn: ONE ARM ON THE BENCH, NO PLANS.

tip.ko: 앉아서 쉬는 날엔 목 단추를 두세 개 풀어 셔츠가 몸에 붙지 않게 하고, 그늘에 들어오면 선글라스는 머리 위로 올려 두세요.
tip.en: For a seated afternoon, undo two or three buttons so the shirt doesn't cling, and push the sunglasses up into the hair once you're in the shade.
tip.de: Für einen Nachmittag im Sitzen zwei, drei Knöpfe öffnen, damit das Hemd nicht anliegt, und die Sonnenbrille im Schatten ins Haar schieben.

copy.refinements: Producer delivered titles only (ko/en/de). deck ko/de = producer title, en deck rewritten so it does not repeat the English article title; intro, pull and tip written from the editorial scene. Product how-to-wear = producer text except where noted by sourceHowToWear (production remark or missing verb).
